questions.stem: What do the students do before the centre opens?
questions.explanation: The passage says: "Its owner shows old photographs of the street in the window. While we wait, we compare the pictures with the buildings around us. A tall wall in one photograph no longer stands, but the little bridge remains." This supports the answer: "Compare old street photographs with present buildings.".
questions.parentExplanation: 对应原文：店主把这条街的老照片摆在橱窗里。 等待时，我们把照片与周围建筑比较。 一张照片上的高墙已不见，小桥却还在。 因此正确选项为“Compare old street photographs with present buildings.”。

questions.stem: What is the passage mainly about?
questions.explanation: The passage says: "Our class takes a bus to a small local history centre. We arrive at the centre early, before its front doors open. The teacher shows us a bakery across from the entrance on the opposite side of the road. Its owner shows old photographs of the street in the window. While we wait, we compare the pictures with the buildings around us. A tall wall in one photograph no longer stands, but the little bridge remains. By opening time, we already have questions about changes in the neighbourhood." This supports the answer: "An early arrival leads to questions about local changes".
questions.parentExplanation: 对应原文：我们班坐公交车去一家小型地方历史中心。 我们很早到达中心，前门还没有开。 老师给我们看入口对面马路另一边的面包店。 店主把这条街的老照片摆在橱窗里。 等待时，我们把照片与周围建筑比较。 一张照片上的高墙已不见，小桥却还在。 开门时，我们已经有了关于社区变化的问题。 因此正确选项为“An early arrival leads to questions about local changes”。

passages.text: Our class takes a bus to a small local history centre. We arrive at the centre early, before its front doors open. The teacher shows us a bakery across from the entrance on the opposite side of the road. Its owner shows old photographs of the street in the window. While we wait, we compare the pictures with the buildings around us. A tall wall in one photograph no longer stands, but the little bridge remains. By opening time, we already have questions about changes in the neighbourhood.

parallelText.en: Our class takes a bus to a small local history centre.
parallelText.zh: 我们班坐公交车去一家小型地方历史中心。

parallelText.en: We arrive at the centre early, before its front doors open.
parallelText.zh: 我们很早到达中心，前门还没有开。

parallelText.en: The teacher shows us a bakery across from the entrance on the opposite side of the road.
parallelText.zh: 老师给我们看入口对面马路另一边的面包店。

parallelText.en: Its owner shows old photographs of the street in the window.
parallelText.zh: 店主在橱窗里展示这条街的旧照片。

parallelText.en: While we wait, we compare the pictures with the buildings around us.
parallelText.zh: 等待时，我们把照片与周围建筑比较。

parallelText.en: A tall wall in one photograph no longer stands, but the little bridge remains.
parallelText.zh: 一张照片里的高墙已不再矗立，但小桥仍然保留着。

parallelText.en: By opening time, we already have questions about changes in the neighbourhood.
parallelText.zh: 到开门时，我们已经对街区的变化产生了许多问题。
